import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a countplot of brand distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='brand', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Camera Brands')
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram of megapixels distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.histplot(data['megapixels'], bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Megapixels')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of average price by brand
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='brand', y='price_usd', data=data.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().reset_index())
plt.title('Average Price by Brand')
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Average Price (USD)')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot of price vs megapixels
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', data=data)
plt.title('Price vs Megapixels')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a boxplot of price by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=data)
plt.title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
